text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hi, coming in! Suzuka, howdy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki...? And everyone else too...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There's a resort near the training lodge, 
right? We're all going together, so how 
about you come too, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: With everyone... to a lively place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
……It's okay to just spend time like I 
always do. Right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Yes. I'll come along as well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Suzuka, let's get dressed up and go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yahoo~! So sparkly! So chilly! The ocean 
is the absolute best, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Suzukaaa? Where are you~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...! Heheh, the waves 
washing over my legs... feel so nice and 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, haha! Suzuka is enjoying herself too, 
isn't she~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You really love strawberry flavor, 
Suzuka! Hey, try this dragon fruit flavor 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A rare flavor... Hehe,
let me have a bite 
then."

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I bought a summer dress! What did 
you all get~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What should I do...? The right one is 
nice,
but the left one is hard to pass up, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzukaa, are you troubled? Suzuka looks 
very cute no matter what you wear...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? Are these... horseshoe shoes!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with mesh material I worry about
dirt 
getting in... but I still want 
breathability.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! That's so like you,
Suzuka~! Let's 
ponder it to your heart's content!

While taking a walk along the beach, I 
spotted Silence Suzuka playing with 
handheld sparklers.

It would be tactless to pour cold water
on 
their high spirits. I decided to quietly 
step away.
(*tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Huh, shouldn't you be with the others?
Huh, shouldn't you be with everyon...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Wait, shouldn't you be with everyo...
Wait, shouldn't you be with everyo...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I just thought I'd go wherever I felt
like 
going...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Even when I'm around everyone,
I can go 
wherever and move however I want...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt that...
it was okay to just 
be myself.
choice_data_list: I see, I'm glad you had a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes... Following one's heart is... 
so very...
choice_data_list: I see, I'm glad you had a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It feels... so good...

Her voice gradually grew quieter as she 
was lured into dreamland.
Having played so 
much, a pleasant exhaustion had washed 
over her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, ...right... From now on, too... 
here..."
choice_data_list: That's just fine, from now on too.

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her fall quietly asleep, I draped 
my coat over her. I decided to leave her 
like this for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*.

I scooped her up after she had completely 
fallen asleep, explained the situation to 
her friends, and decided to head back to 
the training camp lodge ahead of the 
others—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... san.

When I answered, she smiled contentedly. 
Listening to her steady breathing as she 
slept, I carried her all the way back to 
the training camp lodge.

The exhaustion from playing must have 
finally caught up with her. Coming here 
might have been an unconscious search for 
a place to restâ

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Whenever you're tired, come take a...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
